title: MZ Issues with VisuStella's Picture Choices Plugin?

posts.author: Allusion
posts.body:
Hey, everyone! I was just wondering if anyone out there who has bought this plugin could offer a little advice? I've been trying to get their
Picture Choices
to work forever now, and no matter what I do the effects of the plugin don't trigger at all.
It's supposed to be able to hide the choice windows--it doesn't. It's supposed to be able to ease pictures in and out when selected--it doesn't.
I can't tell if I'm doing something wrong or if the plugin is buggy or what. (╥﹏╥) This is the case in a vanilla project, too. Has anyone ever had this happen before? Was there a solution? I just re-downloaded the plugin in case there were updates, but it hasn't changed anything.
Here is an image of the event in question; (I removed the hide choice tag, but it didn't work even when it was applied, so...)

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: This thread was moved from RPG Maker MZ Support to JavaScript/Plugin Support.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
You do show picture first, and the commands run in order. So your change to easing has no chance to run. Try it first in the order.
I also see nothing where you set it up to hide the choice windows either. Is that in another setting? (edit: Saw your note about hiding that later, so ignore that part).
Edit: Also is show picture even needed? Or is that taken care of with the bind picture in your show choices? I wonder if it will work if you remove the show pictures?

posts.author: Allusion
posts.body: Hey, there! I just tried it in the order you suggested but nothing happened. And yes, VS does say the show picture command is mandatory. Luckily, I found a bug report link to them and submitted this issue! Hopefully it will be resolved soon. I'll post the solution here if so!

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body: Ok sounds good. That is all I could think of based on what I read as I've not used it (yet). Let us know what you find.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Hmmm, it works for me (though not all of my plugins are up to date). Just to be sure, you did change the easing options right?
By default they all seem to be on "unchanged", so unless you change them, you see no effects when hovering on pictures.
edit: meant easing + other options
